title: Add edit/delete for categories shown below Favorites

requirements.text: Provide a way to edit (rename) and delete categories directly from the category list displayed below the "Favorites" control (the category badges area in the filter bar).

quotes: It works perfect! Now I need to be able to delete or edit the categories.

acceptanceCriteria: When categories are visible under the Favorites control, the user can initiate rename and delete actions from that same area (without needing to navigate elsewhere).
Rename and delete actions are available for each category shown in the filter bar.

requirements.text: Limit category editing to name-only changes, and persist category renames end-to-end: update the categories list and update any prompts currently using the category so they reference the new category name.

quotes: 2) Just the category, everything else is editable.

acceptanceCriteria: Renaming a category changes only its name (no other prompt fields are modified).
After rename completes, prompts that previously contained the old category name now contain the new category name.
After rename completes, the old category no longer appears in the categories list and the new category does appear.
If the renamed category was currently selected as a filter, the UI transitions cleanly (e.g., selection updates to the new name or clears selection) without errors.

requirements.text: When deleting a category, detach it from prompts (remove that category from each prompt’s categories array) and keep the prompts themselves; then remove the category from the categories list and backend storage.

quotes: 3) No, nothing else should be linked to it. Detach the items and keep them.

acceptanceCriteria: Deleting a category does not delete any prompts.
After deletion, prompts that had the deleted category no longer include it in their categories list.
After deletion, the category no longer appears in the categories list (including the filter bar).
If the deleted category was currently selected as a filter, the selection is cleared automatically.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Adding additional category fields beyond name (e.g., description editing UI).
Deleting prompts as a side effect of deleting a category.
